name: Reconcile corrected local evidence with resolving citations
prompt: Research the supplied local evidence collection and write recommendation.json for an EU-only support service needing at least 1500 requests/month and a monthly cost of at most EUR 150. Compare the Aster and Birch plans using the latest applicable facts. A later correction explicitly supersedes the earlier source; distinguish an announcement from an effective change. Required JSON: as_of = 2026-03-15; selected_plan; facts with aster_monthly_eur,aster_requests,aster_region,birch_monthly_eur,birch_requests,birch_region,aster_change_effective; citations object with exactly these same seven fact keys. Each citation is {source_id,start_line,end_line}, using the source_id stem of a supplied .txt file and 1-indexed inclusive lines. Cite one to three contiguous supporting lines for each fact; do not cite an unrelated source, the entire collection or a superseded value. Select the cheapest plan satisfying all three requirements. Preserve every evidence file. You may add a prose rationale, but it cannot replace the structured facts and citations. Use only this fixed collection; no live web lookup is required.
